theorem QOU.BraidKnot.markovTrace_disjointProduct {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {markovTrace : ℕ → List ℤ → R} {embedRight : List ℤ → ℕ → List ℤ} {z : R} (hmT : IsMarkovTrace markovTrace embedRight z) (k n : ℕ) (α β : List ℤ) (hβ : ∀ b ∈ β, 0 ≤ b) :
markovTrace n (α ++ embedRight β (k + 1)) = markovTrace k α * markovTrace (n - k - 1) β

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IsMarkovTrace.eq_pow_length {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {mT : ℕ → List ℤ → R} {embedRight : List ℤ → ℕ → List ℤ} {z : R} (h : IsMarkovTrace mT embedRight z) (n : ℕ) (w : List ℤ) (hw : ∀ c ∈ w, 0 ≤ c) :
mT n w = z ^ w.length

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IsMarkovTrace.append_cost {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {mT : ℕ → List ℤ → R} {embedRight : List ℤ → ℕ → List ℤ} {z : R} (h : IsMarkovTrace mT embedRight z) (α γ : List ℤ) :
(∀ c ∈ γ, 0 ≤ c) → mT 0 (α ++ γ) = z ^ γ.length * mT 0 α

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IsMarkovTrace.peel {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {mT : ℕ → List ℤ → R} {embedRight : List ℤ → ℕ → List ℤ} {z : R} (h : IsMarkovTrace mT embedRight z) {b : ℤ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (w : List ℤ) :
mT 0 (w ++ [b]) = z * mT 0 w

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IsMarkovTrace.ambient_irrelevant {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {mT : ℕ → List ℤ → R} {embedRight : List ℤ → ℕ → List ℤ} {z : R} (h : IsMarkovTrace mT embedRight z) (n : ℕ) (w : List ℤ) :
mT n w = mT 0 w

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.disjointProduct_independent_of_strip_cyclic_embed :
∃ (mT : ℕ → List ℤ → ℤ) (embedRight : List ℤ → ℕ → List ℤ) (z : ℤ), (∀ (n : ℕ) (w : List ℤ), mT (n + 1) (w ++ [Int.ofNat n]) = z * mT n w) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (u v : List ℤ), mT n (u ++ v) = mT n (v ++ u)) ∧ (∀ (β : List ℤ) (j : ℕ), embedRight β j = List.map (fun (x : ℤ) => x + Int.ofNat j) β) ∧ ¬∀ (k n : ℕ), k + 2 ≤ n → ∀ (α β : List ℤ), mT n (α ++ embedRight β (k + 1)) = mT k α * mT (n - k - 1) β

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.markovTrace_strip_ascendingRun_left {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {mT : ℕ → List ℤ → R} {embedRight : List ℤ → ℕ → List ℤ} {z : R} (hmT : IsMarkovTrace mT embedRight z) (n m : ℕ) (w : List ℤ) :
mT (n + m) (ascendingRun n m ++ w) = z ^ m * mT n w

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.markovTrace_strip_ascendingRun {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {mT : ℕ → List ℤ → R} {embedRight : List ℤ → ℕ → List ℤ} {z : R} (hmT : IsMarkovTrace mT embedRight z) (n : ℕ) (w : List ℤ) (m : ℕ) :
mT (n + m) (w ++ ascendingRun n m) = z ^ m * mT n w

ℕ → List ℤ

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IsMarkovTrace.stable {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {mT : ℕ → List ℤ → R} {embedRight : List ℤ → ℕ → List ℤ} {z : R} (self : IsMarkovTrace mT embedRight z) (n : ℕ) (w : List ℤ) :

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IsMarkovTrace.normalised {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {mT : ℕ → List ℤ → R} {embedRight : List ℤ → ℕ → List ℤ} {z : R} (self : IsMarkovTrace mT embedRight z) (n : ℕ) :

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IsMarkovTrace.embed_disjoint {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {mT : ℕ → List ℤ → R} {embedRight : List ℤ → ℕ → List ℤ} {z : R} (self : IsMarkovTrace mT embedRight z) (β : List ℤ) (j : ℕ) :
embedRight β j = List.map (fun (x : ℤ) => x + Int.ofNat j) β

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IsMarkovTrace.cyclic {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {mT : ℕ → List ℤ → R} {embedRight : List ℤ → ℕ → List ℤ} {z : R} (self : IsMarkovTrace mT embedRight z) (n : ℕ) (u v : List ℤ) :
mT n (u ++ v) = mT n (v ++ u)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IsMarkovTrace.strip {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {mT : ℕ → List ℤ → R} {embedRight : List ℤ → ℕ → List ℤ} {z : R} (self : IsMarkovTrace mT embedRight z) (n : ℕ) (w : List ℤ) :
mT (n + 1) (w ++ [Int.ofNat n]) = z * mT n w
